title: Clean Air Act — Statute profile
subject: Clean Air Act
summary: Clean Air Act is a statute of United States enacted in 1963, in the area of environmental protection. Federal law controlling air pollution and setting air quality standards. It is formally cited as Pub. L. 88-206.
key_points: Core effect: Federal law controlling air pollution and setting air quality standards.
guidance: General information only, not legal advice. Use the citation to look up the current official text; statutes are amended over time.
